passages.quote:
This guidance explains how police should carry out their duties under section 4B of the Public Order Act 1986.

It applies to:

chief officers of police

the chief constable of the British Transport Police Force

the chief constable of the Ministry of Defence Police

the chief constable of the Civil Nuclear Constabulary

The information in this guidance may also help:

criminal justice agencies and statutory bodies

non-governmental and voluntary organisations working with victims or others affected by the offence
